notes.title: Version 1.1.2cb5430 (Patch 1)
notes.notes:
Defenders of the West, today is an exciting day! We recently completed our first patch which introduces a few player requested features, includes the release of our original soundtrack as DLC, and contains a few user-experience/bug fixes; please see the patch notes below. Finally, the team recently did a talk and panel discussion at the monthly meeting of IGDA DC which you can read about on our blog and briefly discusses what is next for our team and Tumbleweed Express (if your interested in that sort of thing): http://dirigiballers.blogspot.com/2016/07/a-tale-of-54-game-jams-presentation-and.html

Cheers, 

The Dirigiballers, LLC

=============== 

Tumbleweed Express: v1.1.2cb5430 Patch Notes

NEW FEATURES:
+Train Painting: Players can now customize the color scheme of their train via the Paint Job panel in the Warehouse Depot
+Hold Fire Mode: Automatic Turrets can now be instructed to hold their fire via the Battle Menu target priority interface. This will help players complete contracts that their turrets may have been interfering with

BUG FIXES:
+Fixed looter enemies occasionally skipping over their looting animations
+Fixed case where Drillcar Jim would pass through the player’s train during the Cactus Plains town fight
+Fixed Wagons occasionally not registering TNT hits for contract credit
+Fixing map alignment offset in levels The Foothills (1.2) and West Canyon City (3.2)

MISCELLANEOUS :
+Normalized distance culling (disappearing for performance) of Cacti for all graphics quality settings
+Normalized shadow draw distance for all graphics quality settings
+Added new Paint Job tip to the Warehouse loading screen
+Minor performance overhead tweaks
+Drillcar intro-cutscene now specifically refers to the enemy as a ‘Drillcar Looter’ to reduce contract confusion
+Improved slider functionality in all menus
+Improved Fireball trajectory to always pass through the player’s crosshair.
+Some environmental polishing in The Heights (0.2)
+Tweaking credits read outs and background art
+Updated default graphics quality on launcher to "Good" (from "Fastest")

notes.title: June Podcast, Presentation, and Game Jam
notes.notes:
Defenders of the West, thank you for all your support and great feedback  thus far. We wanted to provide you with a little bit of information about our upcoming schedule:

PODCAST (June 21st, 2016 @ 7 PM EST)
Tomorrow night members of our development team will be joining the "Guys Games and Beer" podcast to review the game, discuss the the development process, and probably preview a little bit about the future of the game going forward. Please join us or catch the podcast episode later on when it is posted. If you have any particular questions, feel free to post them below and we'll try to answer them to the best of our abilities. Tune in tomorrow via Twitch: 
http://www.guysgamesandbeer.net/

PRESENTATION (June 28th, 2016 @ 6:30 PM EST)
Next week we will be giving a presentation about our 4.5 year development story at our local IGDA Chapter meeting, which is completely free and open to the public. If you happen to be in the DC area and plan to attend, please RSVP via Facebook: 
https://www.facebook.com/events/676333429158248/

GAME JAM (June 24th, 2016)
Our team will be conducting game jam 54, which is the main event for processing feedback and making updates to Tumbleweed Express. This jam in particular will be the first opportunity for the majority of the team to meet and discuss our plans for future updates to the game. If you have made comments, sent us an email, or posted a YouTube video then you can be sure that the entire team will discussing it during this weekend long development session. Following this development meeting, we'll be able to release a more detailed plan for the future of the game and we should be zeroing in on a release date for our first patch.

Cheers, 

The Dirigiballers, LLC

notes.title: Version 1.0.3ada161 (Hotfix 1)
notes.notes:
Defenders of the West, thank you for your patience and for being so awesome! Our team has tried to address much of your initial feedback with this patch and will continue to investigate the other known issues that remain. Stay tuned for more updates and please continue to let us know how things are going. Cheers, 

The Dirigiballers, LLC

===============

Tumbleweed Express: v1.0.3ada161 Patch Notes

BUG FIXES
+Fixed Drillcar engine sound effects not playing
+Slight Act1 performance improvements
+Fixed Traincars not being healed by Engineers if there were five Engineers assigned to it
+Cleaning up some typos here and there
+Fixed contract data not being reset correctly when hitting the Retry button in the pause menu or in the results menu.
+Fixed InvertX and InvertY not appropriately applying their settings.
+Fixed Sensitivity not appropriately applying its setting.
+Fixed Warehouse Ship Out world map buttons becoming unresponsive if player backed out of the Ship Out menu while mousing over the level description.

BALANCE CHANGES
+Speeder contracts now give credit for both Shooter and Looter speeder kills since it was difficult to differentiate between the two, but Speeder contract requirements have been increased to compensate.
+Added some more wagons to Level 1.1, Cactus Plains.
+Reduced cash value of Act 2 Oil Rig buildings

MISCELLANEOUS 
+Updated results 'retry' button to say 'replay' to better communicate the fact that it does not take back payout or level results.
+Cleaned up old controller input references in the player controller that may have been causing player’s weapons to fire continuously without input.
